name: debug-companions-prod
title: Debug Companions production
description: Read-only production debugging for the Companions runtime: Railway status and logs, box.ascii.dev inventory, and named read-only PostgreSQL queries, all credential-redacted.
notes: Operator-machine only. Never publish this skill to a hub and never install it on a hosted Companion: it declares operator credentials (Railway token, Box API key, production database URL) that must never cross the credential boundary in deploy/railway/README.md — the Box key and database URLs are runtime-service-only in production. The single mutating script (railway_restart.py) is double-gated behind an explicit flag plus DEBUG_PROD_ALLOW_RESTART=1 and never targets the release service.

RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID.description: Railway project id containing the web, api, worker, runtime, and release services.

RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID.description: Railway environment id (production) used to filter deployments and logs.

COMPANION_BOX_API_BASE.description: box.ascii.dev API base URL; defaults to https://ascii.dev/api/box/v1.

RAILWAY_API_TOKEN.description: Railway API token (personal/team bearer token or project access token) with read access to the project; restart additionally requires DEBUG_PROD_ALLOW_RESTART=1.

COMPANION_BOX_API_KEY.description: box.ascii.dev API key used strictly for GET /boxes and GET /boxes/{id}; production services other than runtime must never hold this.

PROD_DATABASE_READ_URL.description: PostgreSQL URL for a READ-ONLY production role; every query is additionally wrapped in BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY.

commands.name: Triage production
commands.desc: railway_status, db_query gate+health, and recent runtime error logs — the first five minutes.

commands.name: Explain a dead or stalled chat
commands.desc: Distinguish decision expiry, pi_event_stream_interrupted, and turn_stalled for one turn.

commands.name: Inspect provider Boxes
commands.desc: List generation-qualified Boxes for a Companion and surface duplicate-generation evidence.

commands.name: Restart one service (gated)
commands.desc: Double-gated deployment restart that prints runbook preconditions and never targets release.
